title: ID0399571-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/S2 313518164001] Connectors not functioning
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Connectors not functioning
Root cause:
Too long cooldown phase of Power converters, power re-alignment and cablecheck routine.
Solution: This topic will be solved in v8.0 and will consist of several improvements on soft-plc code
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: No

04/28/2026

EVC3-8361

additional_info.subject: 0399571 - ID0399571-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/S2 313518164001] Connectors not functioning CRM:00314000147
additional_info.body:
Good morning Sebastien,
I am reaching out regarding ticket
ID0399571
for the parallel abortions on AUTORECHARGE. I just saw your note asking for an update, sorry for the late response.
From what I saw in the logs from the field, the parallel charging interruptions appear only in a specific scenario, i.e. when the first truck is charging at high power (all converter groups in use). Due to the intrinsic nature of this type of charging (High voltage charging sessions, circa 700V), when the second truck is connected, the Cable check lasts too long, and it exceeds the CableCheck timeout established by the standard ISO15118-20, which is of 38 seconds. If the timeout is exceeded, the truck interrupts the charging attempt.
I already brought my findings to R&D and they also noticed that the time to cooldown the power converters, re-group the power converters and perform
Cable check routines (OGC, IMD, Power Modules ramp up, ramp down)
it is exceeding the timeout given by the standard. This scenario happens only in a particular occasion, that is with EVs charging at high voltage and when the first outlet is charging at high power (all CG allocated).
This is not a bug of the FW per se, but it will be corrected and improvements shall be done in the FW in order to reduce the time to
free up converter group from other EV charging and allot to incoming EV waiting in cable check. I am still waiting from R&D for a confirmation regarding which FW these improvements will be included in and when it will be released. I will provide you a feedback as soon as I get this information.
With kind regards,

additional_info.subject: Handover from ES to NOC
additional_info.body:
Problem Description
:  When charging with one outlet at HiGH power anf High voltage, the second outlet exceeds the Cablecheck timeout to start.
Suspected Root Cause
:  Too long cooldown phase of Power converters, power re-alignment and cablecheck routine.
Action Performed (ES)
